headline: Grit Assessment, from entry to detail
overview: Answer 12 questions to score on Consistency of Interest and Perseverance of Effort — the two components of grit as defined by Angela Duckworth's research.
targetAudience: Users interested in growth tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

keyFeatures: 12-question assessment based on Angela Duckworth's validated Grit Scale
Separate scores for Consistency of Interest and Perseverance of Effort
Overall grit score with percentile comparison to the general population
Insights into which grit component to develop for long-term goal achievement
tips: Grit predicts long-term achievement better than talent or IQ — if your score is lower than you'd like, the subscale breakdown shows exactly which dimension to work on.
Consistency of Interest (staying passionate) is often harder to develop than Perseverance of Effort — if that's your gap, explore which goals truly align with your values.
